AccessLevel.description: What a tool does to the world. Role grants are scoped by access level.
AccessLevel.title: AccessLevel

ApprovalOverride.description: Per-tool overrides of the global ``approvals`` settings.

approver_roles.description:
Roles allowed to decide this tool's approval requests (default:
``approvals.approver_roles``). Each must hold the ``approvals:decide`` action.
approver_roles.title: Approver Roles

timeout_seconds.description:
Seconds a request may stay ``PENDING_APPROVAL`` before it becomes ``EXPIRED``
(default: ``approvals.timeout_seconds``).
timeout_seconds.title: Timeout Seconds

ApprovalOverride.title: ApprovalOverride

approver_roles.description: Default roles allowed to approve or reject. Each must hold ``approvals:decide``.
approver_roles.title: Approver Roles

timeout_seconds.description:
Seconds a request may stay ``PENDING_APPROVAL`` before it becomes ``EXPIRED``
(an expired request is rejected; it never executes).
timeout_seconds.title: Timeout Seconds

inline_wait_seconds.description:
How long the gateway holds the agent's ``tools/call`` open waiting for a decision.
If no decision arrives in time the call returns ``PENDING_APPROVAL`` with the approval
id, and the agent suspends (checkpoints) until it is decided. Keep this below the load
balancer idle timeout.
inline_wait_seconds.title: Inline Wait Seconds

require_distinct_approver.description: Four-eyes rule: the principal that requested a call can never approve it.
require_distinct_approver.title: Require Distinct Approver

BudgetPolicy.description: Per-session budget enforcement (ledgers live in Redis).

session.description: Default limits for every session; roles may override individual limits.

warn_at_ratio.description: Emit a ``budget.warning`` event once any limit reaches this fraction.
warn_at_ratio.title: Warn At Ratio

ledger_ttl_seconds.description:
Idle time after which a session's ledger expires. Must outlive every approval
timeout so a ledger cannot expire while a call awaits approval.
ledger_ttl_seconds.title: Ledger Ttl Seconds

BudgetPolicy.title: BudgetPolicy

CircuitBreakerPolicy.description: What happens once loop detection trips.

cooldown_seconds.description: How long a tripped breaker blocks every tool call in the session.
cooldown_seconds.title: Cooldown Seconds

require_manual_reset.description: Keep a tripped breaker open until an operator resets it, ignoring the cooldown.
require_manual_reset.title: Require Manual Reset

CircuitBreakerPolicy.title: CircuitBreakerPolicy

ControlAction.description: Control-plane permissions, used by the operator console and its API.
ControlAction.title: ControlAction

LoopDetectionPolicy.description: Trips the circuit breaker when an agent repeats an identical call.

max_identical_calls.description:
Identical calls (same session, tool and canonical arguments) allowed within the
window. The next identical call trips the breaker.
max_identical_calls.title: Max Identical Calls

window_seconds.description: Sliding window over which identical calls are counted.
window_seconds.title: Window Seconds

LoopDetectionPolicy.title: LoopDetectionPolicy

ModelPrice.description: USD per million tokens, by token type, as billed by the model provider.

cache_write_5m_per_mtok.description: Prompt-cache writes with the default 5-minute TTL.
cache_write_5m_per_mtok.title: Cache Write 5M Per Mtok

ModelPrice.title: ModelPrice

PolicyMetadata.description: Identifies the policy in decision logs, traces and the operator console.

name.description: Identifier recorded with every policy decision (alongside the file digest).
name.title: Name

PolicyMetadata.title: PolicyMetadata

PricingPolicy.description: Converts reported token usage into USD for budget enforcement.

models.description: Prices keyed by the model id the provider reports in its response.
models.title: Models

fallback.description:
Applied to usage from any model not listed in ``models``. Must be at least as
expensive as every listed model, so an unpriced model can only over-count.

PricingPolicy.title: PricingPolicy

RiskTier.description:
Business impact if a tool is misused. Surfaced to operators; ``critical`` tools
must require approval.
RiskTier.title: RiskTier

RoleGrant.description: Allows the tools matched by ``tools`` whose ``access`` is listed in ``access``.

tools.description:
Case-sensitive glob patterns over qualified tool names (``*`` and ``?`` only),
e.g. ``crm-ops__*``. Each pattern must match at least one registered tool.
tools.title: Tools

access.description: Access levels covered. A matched tool is allowed only if its access is listed.
access.title: Access

RoleGrant.title: RoleGrant

RolePolicy.description: A role named by the JWT ``role`` claim.

description.description: What the role is for. Shown in the operator console.
description.title: Description

inherits.description:
Roles whose ``allow``, ``deny`` and ``actions`` are merged into this one
(transitively). Budgets are not inherited.
inherits.title: Inherits

allow.description: Tool grants (data plane). Nothing is allowed unless a grant matches.
allow.title: Allow

deny.description:
Glob patterns that are always denied, overriding every grant (including inherited
ones). Unlike grants, deny patterns may guard tools that are not registered yet.
deny.title: Deny

actions.description: Control-plane actions this role may perform.
actions.title: Actions

budget.description: Overrides individual ``budgets.session`` limits for sessions of this role.

RolePolicy.title: RolePolicy

SessionBudget.description:
Hard caps for one agent session (JWT ``sid``). Exceeding any one denies further
tool calls in the session.

max_total_tokens.description: All tokens reported for the session: input, output, cache writes and cache reads.
max_total_tokens.title: Max Total Tokens

max_cost_usd.description: Token cost (priced via ``pricing``) plus per-call tool costs.
max_cost_usd.title: Max Cost Usd

SessionBudget.title: SessionBudget

ToolPolicy.description: Governance metadata for one upstream tool. Unregistered tools are denied.

access.description:
``read`` for side-effect-free tools, ``write`` for anything that changes state.
The gateway trusts this classification, never the upstream server's own hints.

risk.description: Business impact if misused. Shown to operators; ``critical`` requires approval.

requires_approval.description: Suspend every call for a human decision before it reaches the upstream server.
requires_approval.title: Requires Approval

approval.description: Approval settings for this tool; only valid when ``requires_approval`` is true.

cost_usd_per_call.description:
Flat USD charged to the session budget each time the call is forwarded upstream
(e.g. a metered data provider).
cost_usd_per_call.title: Cost Usd Per Call

description.description: Operator-facing note. Never sent to agents.
description.title: Description

ToolPolicy.title: ToolPolicy

version.description: Schema version. Bumped only for incompatible changes.
version.title: Version

roles.description: Roles, keyed by the value of the JWT ``role`` claim.
roles.title: Roles

tools.description:
Registry of every tool the gateway will route, keyed by qualified name
``<server>__<tool>`` (the name agents see). Anything not listed is denied.
tools.title: Tools
